svg.title: Measured oak top - Layered botanical engraving - Whiskey Gin Beer Wine Oak - refined stems and spacing v6
svg.desc: True-scale top-down stepped layout. Long arm 49 1/4 inches, connector 20 inches, short arm 23 3/8 inches, all 8 1/2 inches wide. Both 45-degree miter seams are shown. Engraving follows the exposed continuous front edge.
svg.text: EXPOSED FRONT EDGE - ENGRAVING ON THE TOP FACE
Whiskey + bourbon / gin / beer / wine / oak - v6
Simpler juniper stems; foliage band 5% wider.
TRUE PROPORTIONS - one drawing unit = one inch. Proof only: do not import this annotated wood layout as a cut file.
